Hi Julia —

Thanks again for agreeing to onboard Horton as a Redwood merchant. To complete vendor setup and enable PO routing and payments, can you please send the following items by end-of-day Friday (2026-07-02):

1) Legal entity name exactly as it appears on tax documents
2) EIN / Tax ID and tax classification (C corp, LLC, sole proprietor, etc.)
3) W-9 (or W-8 if non-US) — PDF preferred
4) Remittance / invoicing address and a preferred remit-to email for e-invoicing
5) Bank routing information for ACH and wire (bank name, account type, routing number, SWIFT/BIC if international)
6) Confirm whether Horton requires PO numbers on invoices and (if so) who should receive the PO in your team (name/email)
7) Any special invoice cadence or payment terms (Net30, Net45, etc.)
8) Point of contact for procurement/ accounts-payable

I attached a short buyer intake form to speed this up — you can fill it and return it to me. If you prefer, send the W-9 and bank letter directly and we can onboard from there.

Next steps on our side: Monica will validate bank details and provisioning in our ERP once we receive docs; Vivek will confirm PO workflow and update Salesforce with the vendor record. Once setup is complete we will share Redwood vendor code and a sample PO template.

Thanks — let me know if you need more time.

Best,
Ethan Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
